name: Brigindo

attributes.attribute: a name variant of the goddess Brigit
a divinity who appears in many places

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Brigindo is a name variant of the goddess Brigit. Her variants include Brig, Bride, and Brixia. Brigit stood out among Celtic gods. She appeared in many places. Her feast day is Imbolc, falling on February 1. Ireland still celebrates that day.

okr.objective: Describe Brigindo as a name variant of the goddess Brigit.
key_results: Brigindo is a name variant of the goddess Brigit.
The variants include Brig, Bride, and Brixia.
Brigit appeared in many places across the Celtic world.
Her feast day Imbolc falls on February 1.
